caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF DOUGLAS L. ROMERO
text: Douglas L. Romero, of Denver, Colorado, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of January 13, 2020; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Douglas L. Romero is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
